priorArt.measured: skill workflow holdout generalization 0.39 < 0.6 promotion gate (0.23.29 real cycle, honest rejection on record)
priorArt.attribution: skill-generalization-lab.mts (0.26): TRIGGER/PRECONDITION axis dominates (68% of holdout misses diverge at step 0) + 15/47 all-steps-present-but-reordered (secondary axis, NOT addressed here)
priorArt.preconditionMiner: scripts/precondition-miner.mts (39df0b8) produced SkillSpecV2.preconditions[] SUGGESTIONS as an analysis instrument; the compiler itself never consumed them (toSkillSpecV2 emits preconditions: [] unconditionally) — this experiment closes that loop as the FIRST factor

factor.selected: precondition-aware trigger matching (把 preconditions[] 从'建议字段'接入挖掘与匹配打分)
factor.explicitlyNot: variable-binding abstraction (the 15/47 reordering axis) — reserved as the NEXT factor; one factor per experiment
factor.mechanism: A treats applicability as env-id + strict contiguous containment of the mined n-gram (the gram's first step IS the trigger, so a train-specific opening kills step 0). B separates WHEN-to-fire from WHAT-to-run: structured preconditions mined from TRAIN support trajectories only (preceding action types / position band / goal keywords, each with coverage), used (a) to gate skill-candidate selection toward candidates with a learnable firing context and (b) to score trigger match on unseen trajectories. The procedure body stays a pure contiguous n-gram in BOTH arms — no ordering relaxation leaks in.

corpus.loader: loadTrajectories(home, 2000); usable = steps.length > 0 (same filter as the 0.26 lab)
corpus.hashBasis: sha256 over 'family:<sorted trajectory ids>' lines for the 3 families, computed at freeze time

families.selection: top-3 environments by usable-successful trajectory count (frozen at probe time)

excluded.arc3: 24 successful only, and an abstract-reasoning population (different work shape than agent workflows)
excluded.desktop: 23 usable — below the top-3 cut; kept as documented backup, NOT run

split.perFamily: 70/30 train/holdout inside each family over USABLE trajectories (successful or not)
split.shuffle: mulberry32(hashSeed('real-cycle-2026-10-07')) keyed map-then-sort — byte-identical implementation to the 0.26 lab so the terminal-family arm-A number is same-口径 comparable to the measured 0.39

mining.call: mineWorkflows(train, { minSupport: 2, nMin: 2, nMax: 4 }) — existing defaults, unchanged
mining.armASelection: 现状排序 verbatim: candidates.sort is mineWorkflows' own (steps.length desc, support desc); top-1 = first. Skill = toSkillSpecV2(candidate) (preconditions [] — current behavior). Trigger = env-only: every holdout success 'fires'.
mining.armBSelection: same pool, same order; for EVERY candidate mine preconditions from its TRAIN support trajectories ONLY (holdout never touched by mining/selection/scorer construction): (1) locate the gram's first contiguous-containment start i in each support trajectory; (2) preceding = action types in steps[0..i), keep types with coverage>=0.6 (fraction of support trajectories containing the type in that prefix), sorted by coverage desc, cap 3; (3) positionBand = [p10,p90] nearest-rank quantiles of i/steps.length, produced only when supportUsed>=4; (4) goalKeywords = lowercase tokens (len>=3) of goal.description with coverage>=0.6, cap 3. hasContextSignal := >=1 preceding(cov>=0.6) OR >=1 goalKeyword(cov>=0.6). B top-1 = first candidate (in arm-A order) passing hasContextSignal; if NONE passes => B≡A for that family, recorded as degenerate.
mining.noLookRule: arm B's selection and scorer are built from TRAIN only; holdout is read exactly once, in the run phase, by the frozen scorer

preconditionCheckGrammar.ctx:preceding:<type>: type appears among the trajectory's action types BEFORE the anchor position
preconditionCheckGrammar.ctx:goal:<word>: word (len>=3, lowercase) appears in goal.description tokens
preconditionCheckGrammar.anchorSemantics: anchor = first contiguous-containment start of the FULL gram in the trajectory; if the gram is not contained, anchor = first occurrence of gram[0]'s action type; if gram[0] never occurs, preceding and position conditions are NOT satisfied (goal still evaluable)
preconditionCheckGrammar.unknownChecks: check strings outside this grammar are reported as ignored — never guessed

scoring.triggerMatchScore: score = satisfied/total over the skill's structured precondition checks (env mismatch => score 0 outright); empty preconditions => score 1 flagged vacuous

promotionGate.rule: unchanged and NOT lowered: a skill is promotable in a family only if its full-holdout-success contiguous-containment rate >= 0.6; reported per arm per family whatever the number is

preRegistered.mainEndpoint: per family: contB vs contA — contiguous-containment rate of the arm's selected skill over ALL holdout successes (same 口径 as the measured 0.39; arm A's trigger is env-only so its matched set IS the full holdout set)
preRegistered.significance: per family: exact McNemar two-sided over per-trajectory paired containment flags (A vs B), p<0.05; plus seeded task-level bootstrap 95% CI (10k resamples) on the paired rate difference as a check

verdictRule.POSITIVE: >=2/3 families contB>=contA AND no family contB < contA-0.05 AND >=1 family with contB>contA and McNemar p<0.05
verdictRule.WEAK-POSITIVE: >=2/3 families contB>=contA AND no family contB < contA-0.05 AND no significant family
verdictRule.MIXED: some family improves and some degrades by >0.05 without dominating pattern
verdictRule.NEGATIVE: >=2/3 families contB<contA (honest negative is a legal deliverable)
verdictRule.NEEDS-DATA: >=2 families are low-power (holdout successes <10), or a family pool degenerates (no mined candidates) — stated as NEEDS-DATA with what is missing

preRegistered.lowPower: family with <10 holdout successes is flagged low-power; it still reports numbers but cannot alone drive POSITIVE/NEGATIVE

secondaryEndpoint.name: trigger precision (mechanism check: do mined preconditions carry real information?)
secondaryEndpoint.definition: P@tau = |contains AND matched| / |matched| for the B skill per family; baseline is arm A's env-only trigger whose precision IS contA; effective iff >=2/3 families P_B > contA with that family's matchRate M1>=0.2 (a matcher that fires on <20% of cases proves nothing even at precision 1)
alsoReported: vacuous-skill flag if B skill has zero structured preconditions

preRegistered.perCase: every holdout success carries {family, id, containsA, containsB, matchedB, scoreB, satisfiedChecks, totalChecks}
honestyClauses: negative results reported as negatives (三臂 discipline)
promotion gate 0.6 never lowered, never re-defined
holdout never feeds mining, selection, thresholds, or grammar
degenerate families (empty pool / no-signal pool) recorded, not papered over
all rules frozen HERE before implementation; any deviation logged in REPORT.md as an execution deviation

cost.llmTokens: zero — this is a corpus-replay experiment (mining/scoring are pure local computation), no API calls; wallclock ms per phase recorded on disk
cost.noApiNote: the 429 phase-boundary rule is structurally inapplicable (no network); recorded here so its absence is a stated fact, not an omission

artifacts.reports: REPORT.md (execution deliverable) + report.md (machine verdict, enum-locked language)
